limitations: Positive-case autoplay uses explicit synthetic observation events, never real sensor or operator acknowledgements
No workstation docking or arm motion starts while the corresponding person-clear observation is absent or invalid
Other vehicles remain on the checked aisle waiting positions while one handoff executes; this does not qualify arbitrary arm/vehicle concurrency
Each illustrative cargo ID has one owner and a preserved rigid attachment at handovers; this display fixture is not a workflow inventory or execution journal
Manual occupancy pauses the preview and requires a new explicit synthetic clearance; it is not a qualified physical arm-braking or transporter safety function
Transport cover removal/replacement and vessel confirmations remain explicit manual roles, depicted by synthetic events; no automatic cover actuator
